description:
About the Role: 

 The Configuration Developer is responsible for implementing and maintaining business rules within FireLight®, Hexure’s proprietary SaaS electronic fulfillment platform. This role builds on foundational configuration skills to handle moderately complex business logic, ensuring that financial product applications are completed “In-Good-Order” with accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

 The role operates across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirements understanding through configuration, testing, and deployment, while also supporting production issues. The Configuration Developer I collaborates closely with internal teams and clients to deliver high-quality solutions, improve user experience, and meet project timelines and KPIs.

 This role actively leverages AI-enabled tools to improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency in rule creation, testing, and troubleshooting, reducing rework and enhancing productivity.

  

 Responsibilities: 

 
       Configure and maintain business rules within FireLight® to drive accurate and compliant user experiences for financial product applications

       Implement configuration components including Role Codes, Review Queues, Needs Determination, mapping documents, and admin mappings

      Ensure applications meet “In-Good-Order” standards across completeness, compliance, and business requirements

       Participate across the SDLC including requirements understanding, configuration, testing, and deployment support

       Perform unit and integration testing to validate accuracy and quality of configured business rules

       Support customer deployments, ensuring timely and accurate implementation of configurations

       Monitor and resolve issues via ticketing systems (e.g., Jira), ensuring timely turnaround and minimal client disruption

       Provide Tier 2 production support by troubleshooting configuration-related issues and triaging client tickets

       Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve defects, improve configurations, and enhance platform performance

        Use AI tools to accelerate rule creation, scenario testing, and issue investigation to improve efficiency and reduce rework

       Ensure adherence to coding best practices including simplicity, modularity, and reusability

       Meet utilization, productivity, and quality benchmarks, including low churn and on-time delivery

       Actively participate in team meetings, providing clear updates on progress, risks, and dependencies

 
  

 Qualifications: 

 
 1–3 years of experience in a technical or configuration-focused role

 Strong proficiency in XML (creation, editing, troubleshooting) and understanding of structured business logic

 Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in a SaaS environment

 Familiarity with FireLight® platform components and configuration concepts (or ability to ramp quickly)

 Working knowledge of tools such as Jira (ticketing), OpenAir (time tracking), Notepad++ (rule development), and Adobe Acrobat

 Exposure to integrations with third-party platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Redtail, Yellow Pages) is a plus

 Foundational understanding of financial services domain (insurance, annuities, life insurance processes, compliance requirements)

 Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and accuracy

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment

 Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams

 Self-driven with a learning mindset and willingness to adopt new technologies, including AI-enabled tools

 Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively as part of a team

 
  

 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday). 

 

  

 Benefits 

 iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).

 For additional information on iCapital Network, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc
